_comment: Service discovery and mode config for AgentSynapse.
_note_coordinator: Coordinator is now part of AWM (port 8400) when AWM_COORDINATION=true. The separate packages/coordinator/ is deprecated.

models._doc: Default Claude model per agent role. Launchers read this to pass --model to claude CLI. Override per-agent in synapse.workspaces.json.

channels._doc: MCP push channels (Claude Code v2.1.80+). When enabled, launchers pass --channels awm to claude CLI, allowing AWM to push assignments directly to worker sessions instead of polling via /next.
